meta.parties: Commissioner of Stamps v. Logan Et Al

rules.statement: There was no purchase by Hanscomb of the good-will from Henderson for consideration so as to bring it within the exception provided by section 9 (1) of the Estate Duty Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that there was no purchase by Hanscomb of the good-will from Henderson for consideration so as to bring it within the exception provided by section 9 (1) of the Estate Duty Ordinance."
